# Hold On - Justin Bieber

"Hold On" is a song by Canadian singer Justin Bieber, released on March 5, 2021, as the third single from his sixth studio album, *Justice* (2021).

## Background and Release
The song was released through Def Jam Recordings and RBMG, following the previous *Justice* singles "Holy" (featuring Chance the Rapper) and "Anyone." It came out just two weeks before the full album's release on March 19, 2021.

## Production and Writing
"Hold On" was written by Justin Bieber along with Jonathan Bellion, Jon Bellion, Andrew Watt, Ali Tamposi, Louis Bell, and Walter De Backer (Gotye). It was produced by Andrew Watt, Louis Bell, and Jon Bellion. The song reportedly samples elements from Gotye's "Somebody That I Used to Know."

## Musical Style
The track is a pop song with synth-pop elements. Lyrically, it focuses on themes of support, encouraging someone going through difficult times to "hold on" because the singer will be there for them.

## Music Video
The music video, directed by Colin Tilley, was released alongside the single. It features Bieber in a cinematic storyline involving a heist and car chase, with him trying to help someone in need. The video has a dramatic, action-film aesthetic.

## Commercial Performance
- Reached the top 20 on the US Billboard Hot 100
- Charted in the top 10 in several countries including Canada
- Performed well internationally across Europe and Asia

## Reception
The song received generally positive reviews from critics who praised its catchy production and emotional message, though some noted it followed familiar pop conventions.
